jobs.title: Staff Industrial Designer
jobs.description_text: WHAT TO EXPECT Heron Power Electronics is a company building cutting-edge power electronics products for the 21st-century grid. We aim to debottleneck the growth of electricity generation and consumption with scalable, innovative, and less costly hardware solutions, accelerating the sustainable electrification of everything. Our first goal is to build better converters to connect large-scale renewables, storage, and loads like datacenters to the grid. Heron Power's leadership team is made up of seasoned veterans who have designed and shipped gigawatts of power conversion products. We believe great design is an important part of building great technology. Our products are physical machines, digital interfaces, tools, environments, documentation, and a brand—and the experience of Heron is shaped by all of them. We learn together, build together, and solve difficult problems from first principles. You can expect to work in a fast-moving, deeply technical environment where designers work directly with engineers, operators, customers, and leadership to turn complex technology into products and experiences that are clear, useful, thoughtful, and distinctly Heron. JOB OVERVIEW We are looking for a Staff Industrial Designer to help shape the products, experiences, and visual language of Heron Power Electronics. jobs.title: Power Electronics Test & Validation Engineer
jobs.description_text: JOB OVERVIEW The Power Electronics Test & Validation Engineer will own application-specific testing of Heron's solid state transformer (SST) across its core use cases: powering AI data centers, utility-scale BESS, and PV plants. That means bringing up hardware in the lab and at pilot sites, writing scripts to drive test equipment and power converters, and debugging performance against what each application demands, from MPPT performance and PPC/EMS/BMS communication to AI load smoothing and DC protection coordination. You will work hand in hand with the Systems Integration team: they own the SST platform; you own the applications. HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE - Own end-to-end application testing of a novel high C-rate battery pack (SuperBBU) with Heron's SST, validating ripple mitigation, backup capability, slew rates, and power-loss profiles. - Support SST and utility-scale BESS integration testing at pilot sites, covering EMS-to-SST communication, black start and grid-forming coordination, charge/discharge cycling, and round-trip efficiency. - Support integration testing of the SST with commercial off-the-shelf DAS, SCADA and EMS systems. - Own Heron's first pilot deployments: review field performance, identify feature gaps, and work with SW/FW teams to turn findings into product improvements. - Write and maintain Python-based test automation to command power converters, sequence tests, log data, and turn manual procedures into repeatable automated loops. - Safely operate power

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Power Systems Engineer, Grid Interconnection
jobs.description_text: JOB OVERVIEW You will own the grid interconnection of Heron's grid-forming inverters and solid-state transformers (SST) across utility-scale PV, BESS, and large-load projects, carrying each from model development through interconnection studies, utility and ISO approval, and field commissioning. That means building and validating the models grid operators rely on, demonstrating compliance with grid codes and regulation requirements, and closing the loop between simulation, hardware test, and field performance. You will be Heron's technical voice with utilities, ISOs and RTOs, developers' interconnection teams, and customers, working hand in hand with the Controls and Systems Integration teams: they own the inverter platform, you own getting it connected to the grid. That credibility also makes you central to supporting the sales, designing Heron's power systems solutions and giving customers confidence in how our hardware performs on the grid. HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE - Own Heron's inverter and plant models across RMS and EMT platforms (PSS/E, PSLF, PowerFactory, TSAT, and PSCAD), including user-defined models, WECC generic models and their grid-forming variants, and EMT models built from Heron's production controls. - Benchmark models against one another and against controller hardware-in-the-loop, and produce the model validation reports, parameter sheets, and user guides that utilities and ISOs require. - Support interconnection studies for PV, BESS, hybrid, and large-load

jobs.description_text: Our first goal is to build better converters (inverters & rectifiers) to connect large-scale renewables, storage, and loads like datacenters to the grid. jobs.description_text: JOB OVERVIEW As a Staff/Senior Staff Global Supply Manager — Industrial Enclosures, you will lead strategic sourcing and supplier development for the industrial enclosures, fabricated metal components, and mechanical assemblies that make up Heron Link, our solid-state transformer platform. You will own sourcing strategy, supplier selection, cost competitiveness, and manufacturing readiness for critical mechanical hardware. Partnering closely with Design Engineering, Manufacturing, NPI, Finance, and Supply Chain leadership, you will help establish a scalable and resilient supply base capable of supporting Heron's transition from prototype to high-volume production. This role requires strong commercial judgment, deep familiarity with mechanical fabrication supply chains, and the ability to engage directly with suppliers on manufacturing capabilities, costs, capacity, and production challenges. HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE - Define and own category strategies for industrial enclosures, sheet metal fabrication, and mechanical assemblies. - Achieve cost targets through should-cost modeling, manufacturing cost analysis, market intelligence, and supplier negotiations. - Lead RFx processes and negotiate commercial agreements, including piece pricing, tooling/NRE, and contractual terms. - Partner with engineering teams on manufacturability, material selection, fabrication processes, and supplier capabilities. - Drive supplier readiness across prototype, pilot, and mass production builds. -

You will develop and execute sourcing strategies across PCB fabrication and electronics manufacturing partners, ensuring competitive costs, strong supplier performance, manufacturing readiness, and reliable production capacity. Working closely with Electrical Engineering, Hardware Engineering, NPI, Manufacturing, Finance, and Supply Chain leadership, you will help establish a scalable electronics supply chain capable of supporting rapid product development and production growth. jobs.title: Intern, Firmware Engineering
jobs.description_text: JOB OVERVIEW As an Intern, Firmware Engineering, you will be responsible for developing and testing embedded firmware for our power conversion products. Additionally, you will help with hardware bring-up, test automation and development tooling, working alongside experienced firmware and hardware engineers. SALES ENGINEER JAPAN） Our team vision: Illumioのセールスチームは、企業がセキュリティ侵害を封じ込め、ラテラルムーブメント（横展開攻撃）を防ぎ、ハイブリッド環境、クラウド、エンドポイント、そして重要インフラにわたるサイバー・レジリエンスを強化できるよう支援しています。 私たちは、世界有数の大手企業と連携し、IllumioのBreach Containmentプラットフォームを以下のようなビジネス成果へ結び付けています。 - ランサムウェア被害の封じ込め - Zero Trust Segmentationの実現 - アプリケーション可視化 - クラウドモダナイゼーション - AI時代に求められるレジリエンス強化 急成長を続ける当社のセールス組織では、情熱と協調性を持ったプロフェッショナルたちと共に、顧客のサイバーリスク低減と重要資産の保護を支援します。 お客様とのあらゆる対話において、私たちは好奇心、責任感、そして経営層に響くストーリーテリングを大切にしています。お客様が自社環境を正しく理解し、リスクに優先順位を付け、深刻な被害が発生する前に適切なアクションを取れるよう支援しています。 顧客へのインパクト創出、継続的な成長、そしてサイバーセキュリティの未来を共に築いていきたい方にとって、Illumioは理想的な環境です。 業務内容 シニア セールスエンジニアとして、担当エリアのお客様との信頼関係構築を担い、プレゼンテーション、ウェビナー、展示会などを通じてIllumioのソリューションを提案していただきます。 また、顧客のビジネス課題を深く理解し、デモンストレーションやPOV（Proof of Value）を通じて価値を実証しながら、案件の成約および導入成功を支援します。 成果は、売上目標の達成、顧客導入・活用の促進、およびサイバーセキュリティ領域、Illumio製品、セールススキルに関する専門性によって評価されます。 主な業務 - 担当地域において、技術部門および経営層の双方との関係を構築・強化し、Illumioの採用を推進する - 対面およびオンラインでのプレゼンテーションやウェビナーを実施する - 展示会、イベント、カンファレンスなどでIllumioを代表する - 顧客のビジネス目標や期待成果を理解し、提案活動全体をそれらに沿って推進する - ユースケースや顧客事例に基づいた効果的なデモを実施する - POVや案件推進を対面またはリモートで支援する - セキュリティ業界向けのブログ、ホワイトペーパー、技術記事などの作成に貢献する - パートナー企業の技術支援や案件対応をサポートし、双方のビジネス成果を最大化する - 顧客の声を製品開発チームへフィードバックし、今後の機能開発や製品改善を支援する 応募資格 - IT業界またはサイバーセキュリティ業界での実務経験5年以上 - エンタープライズ顧客向けのプリセールスまたはセールスエンジニア経験2年以上 - 優れた

jobs.description_text: ROLE OVERVIEW Harvey is transforming how legal and professional services work gets done. The impact of your decisions compounds across the engineering organization. The next chapter is especially compelling. As both engineers and coding agents contribute more software, we need a platform that makes the right patterns easy to use and the wrong ones difficult to introduce. You’ll help define that foundation: clear architectural boundaries, reusable building blocks, and automated safeguards that let teams ship with confidence. jobs.description_text: It can't yet reason about real places well enough for robots, field crews and AI agents to rely on it, and closing that gap will change how factories, power grids, cities and defense operations run. It learns from years of real-world captures of millions of places, and people, robots and AI agents use it to find out where they are, what is around them and what has changed.
